name: Kuala Lumpur Guan Di Temple
scope: Guan Di Temple on Jalan Tun H.S. Lee in February 2007, including the ornate forecourt gateway, green tiled roof, orange-red street frontage, covered main hall and attached rear mass.

metadataConflicts.reason: Primary source category names the Guan Di Temple in Lahad Datu. Excluded the uploader’s series from the model.

originalReview.notes: Street view shows the green tile and ceramic ridge ensemble, ochre-orange wall, central ornamental gateway, open courtyard and dark main threshold.

review.method: Geotagged exact first-party CC0 Qualla photograph
review.notes: Gary Houston’s exact Qualla file matches his first-party CC0 original, with a description and camera geotag for Kuala Lumpur. The later Foryou42686 series was excluded because two primary exterior releases are categorized under Guan Di Temple Lahad Datu.
